name: SAUNABOX Solara: 1-Person Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna
description: Your personal infrared sanctuary, reimagined. The Solara delivers the deep restorative power of full-spectrum heat and medical-grade red light therapy-refined into a sleek, compact, and beautifully crafted wooden sauna for your home. Every detail of The Solara has been designed for both function and elegance. From its ultra-low EMF infrared panels to its Bluetooth app control, every element works in harmony to create a seamlessly elevated wellness experience. Crafted from 100% Canadian Hemlock, The Solara assembles in under 30 minutes and fits effortlessly into small spaces-bringing the benefits of professional-grade recovery into your daily rhythm. It's innovation, with intention. Wellness, without compromise. KEY FEATURES: → Full Spectrum Low-EMF Infrared Heating → Heats up to 158° F → Certified Free of Toxic Heavy Metals & Phthalates → Bluetooth Speaker System → Medical Grade 660nm Red Light Therapy → 850nm Near Infrared Therapy → Built-in Chromotherapy: Choose from 10 colors → Reflective Glass Door for Privacy → 100% Canadian Hemlock Wood → Free Curbside Delivery SPECIFICATIONS: Heat Levels: Adjustable from 77° - 158° F Near, mid, and far-infrared (NIR, MIR, and FIR) Time Settings: 0-90 minutes Bluetooth Audio System: Connect Your Mobile Device Heater: Ultra-low EMF Infrared Panels Medical-Grade Red Light: 660nm + 850nm Wave Length Red Light Panel: 60 LEDs deliver up to 192 mW/cm² of irradiance Wood Type: 100% Canadian Hemlock Type: Indoor Sauna Voltage: 110V Wattage: 1600 Watts 50/60Hz Size: 35" x 37" x 63" (W x D x H) Power cord length: 8 feet Assembled Weight: 172lbs Warranty: 2-Year
